review_candidates.description: EV Support Engineer Dublin | Full-time | Field & Remote Support The Role: Our client is a growing provider of electric vehicle charging solutions and is looking to hire an experienced EV Support Engineer to join their technical operations team. This is a hands-on support role combining remote troubleshooting, customer support, charger monitoring and occasional field-based technical intervention. You will be responsible for supporting customers and live EV charging infrastructure, resolving technical issues quickly and professionally, and working closely with engineering, suppliers and field-service teams to ensure a high level of network availability and customer satisfaction. Required: 3+ years’ experience in technical or customer support , preferably within EV charging, energy, IoT, telecoms or a related technical environment. Good understanding of electrical systems and basic networking principles. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability. Experience working with ticketing or CRM platforms. Strong communication skills and a professional, customer-focused approach. Ability to take ownership of an issue and manage it through to resolution. Comfortable working independently and remaining calm when dealing with urgent technical incidents. Valid clean driving licence and willingness to travel to customer or project locations when required. Flexibility to participate in an on-call rotation if required. Key Responsibilities: Provide first- and second-line technical support for EV charging equipment and associated software platforms. Diagnose and resolve issues relating to charger functionality, connectivity, configuration and user access. Respond to technical support requests via phone, email and ticketing systems in line with agreed SLAs. Monitor live charging infrastructure for performance, uptime and system alerts. Guide customers through remote troubleshooting and corrective procedures. Escalate more complex technical issues to engineering, product, supplier or field-service teams where required. Track supplier support tickets, warranty issues and equipment returns through to resolution. Maintain accurate records of support cases, technical fixes and known issues. Assist with onboarding new customers and provide basic guidance on charger and platform usage. Configure and support AC EV charging equipment. Attend customer sites where required to investigate, repair or resolve charger issues. Support stock and inventory management for technical equipment and replacement units. Share customer and technical feedback with internal operations and product teams to help improve service quality. The role combines remote support with practical field activity, so you should be equally comfortable troubleshooting technical issues from a desk and attending site when a problem cannot be resolved remotely. Desirable: Previous hands-on experience with EV chargers or field servicing of electrical equipment Degree or relevant qualification in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, IT or another technical discipline .. Familiarity with EV charging protocols and standards such as OCPP, CCS or CHAdeMO. Knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs or IoT protocols. Strong general PC skills and experience with Microsoft 365. The Opportunity: This is a strong opportunity for someone with a background in technical support, electrical systems, field service or EV infrastructure who wants to work in a fast-growing sector. You’ll have the opportunity to work across both the technical and customer-facing sides of EV charging operations, supporting live infrastructure and helping ensure a consistently reliable customer experience.

review_candidates.title: Regional Commissioning Manager
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Regional Commissioning Manager Department: Commissioning Reporting to: Commissioning Director Location: Site-based UK About H&MV Engineering H&MV Engineering is a global leader in high-voltage electrical engineering, powering the transition to a sustainable future. We’re at the cutting-edge of renewable energy, data centres, and complex utility projects - powered by a commitment to continuous improvement and innovation. Our foundation is built on safety, collaboration, and respect. These values shape how we work, how we lead, and how we grow. And at H&MV Engineering, growth isn’t just a goal—it’s a mindset. We invest in our people, offering opportunities to develop, lead, and shape the future of energy. We value passion, motivation, and problem-solving skills, and we believe that diverse perspectives fuel better outcomes. We’re not here to keep up we’re here to lead. H&MV Engineering is offering a strong progression opportunity in Ireland, Europe, the UK, or new international regions for an experienced commissioning engineer ready to step into a broader leadership role. This position is suited to someone who enjoys hands‑on technical commissioning but wants greater influence, ownership, and the chance to lead a regional team delivering major high‑voltage projects. You will help shape commissioning delivery, support engineers, and play a key role in safely energising critical infrastructure across the region About the Role The Regional Commissioning Manager will play a key role in overseeing commissioning delivery across an assigned region, supporting multiple projects and working closely with commissioning teams to ensure works are properly planned, coordinated, delivered, and reported. This role sits within the commissioning management structure and reports to the relevant Commissioning Manager. The position provides a clear link between project delivery teams and commissioning management, ensuring progress, risks, resource requirements, technical issues, and key blockers are understood and managed. This is a strong progression opportunity for an experienced commissioning professional who is ready to move into a wider leadership role. It is suited to someone who can oversee several projects at the same time, support teams on site, work closely with clients and project teams, and help drive safe and successful commissioning delivery. The role is not just about managing people. It is about taking ownership of commissioning delivery across a region, supporting project teams, maintaining strong technical standards, and helping bring projects safely through commissioning and energisation. Key Responsibilities Regional Commissioning Delivery • Oversee commissioning delivery across multiple projects within the assigned region. • Support Project Commissioning Managers, commissioning leads, engineers, technicians, graduates, and specialist teams in the planning and delivery of works. • Ensure commissioning programmes, resources, equipment, documentation, and client requirements are properly understood and managed. • Track progress across regional projects and report key updates, risks, blockers, and resource requirements to the relevant Commissioning Manager. • Help ensure projects are ready for commissioning and energisation, with clear ownership of outstanding actions. • Support the closeout of commissioning issues, snags, documentation, and technical queries. Leadership and Team Support • Provide practical support and guidance to commissioning teams across the assigned region. • Help develop commissioning engineers, senior engineers, technicians, and graduates. • Support teams with planning, fault finding, documentation, technical challenges, and client-facing discussions. • Promote a strong standard of communication, ownership, safety, and quality across the regional team. • Support resource planning to ensure the right people are assigned to the right projects at the right time. • Build a strong team culture across the region, even where teams are spread across different sites. Client, Project, and Internal Coordination • Represent commissioning in project meetings, client meetings, and internal planning discussions. • Work closely with project managers, design teams, protection teams, SCADA teams, operations, quality, safety, vendors, and subcontractors. • Ensure commissioning requirements are understood early and built into the project delivery plan. • Escalate issues early where they could impact commissioning progress, energisation dates, safety, quality, or client confidence. Technical and Quality Oversight • Maintain a strong technical overview of commissioning activities across the region. • Review commissioning documentation, test sheets, redlines, as-built information, and closeout records. • Support FAT attendance, pre-commissioning reviews, walkdowns, and energisation readiness reviews. • Ensure commissioning works are delivered in line with company standards, client requirements, and safe systems of work. • Promote consistency in how commissioning is planned, delivered, recorded, and closed out across projects. Why This Role May Suit You This role may suit you if you are an experienced commissioning engineer, senior commissioning engineer, project commissioning lead, or project commissioning manager who is ready to take the next step into regional management. It gives you the opportunity to lead across multiple projects, support and develop teams, work closely with clients, and have a real influence on how commissioning is delivered across a region. You will remain close to the technical side of the work, while taking on broader responsibility for people, planning, delivery, reporting, and overall regional performance. This is a role for someone who wants ownership, variety, and the opportunity to make a clear impact within a growing commissioning department. H&MV Engineering is an Equal Opportunity Employer We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Ready to energise your career? Join our inclusive team and help build a brighter, more sustainable future—one project at a time.

review_candidates.title: Prosjektsjef
review_candidates.description: Om oss Vi moderniserer infrastrukturen, utvikler knutepunkter og legger til rette for grønn mobilitet. Hos oss vil du oppleve å få kollegaer som brenner for bærekraft og med en sterk tro på og engasjement for å løse oppdraget vårt. Vi ønsker oss kollegaer med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning, fordi inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Det er viktig for oss at våre medarbeidere kjenner seg igjen i verdiene våre – åpen, ansvarlig og lagspiller. Hva betyr disse verdiene for deg, og hvordan tror du de spiller en rolle som prosjektsjef? Teamet/lokasjonen Bane NOR Energi er ansvarlig for å levere og omforme energi fra 50 Hz til 16 2/3 Hz, til strømforsyning til togtrafikken i hele det elektrifiserte jernbanenettet i Norge. Som prosjektsjef Energi vil du ha resultatansvar for Bane NORs prosjektportefølje innen energiforsyningsanlegg. Med på laget har du 12 dyktige prosjekt- og prosjekteringsledere som du vil ha personalansvar for. Stillingen inngår i Bane NOR Energis ledergruppe. Her vil du samarbeide tett med forvaltning, vedlikehold og operativ drift av banestrømforsyningen for å sikre trygg og effektiv leveranse av elektrisk kraft til våre kunder. Lokasjon er i Oslo. For spesielt kvalifiserte kandidater kan lokasjon i Bergen eller Trondheim vurderes. Hva vi verdsetter med å jobbe i Bane NOR Hos oss møter du et engasjert fagmiljø, gode muligheter for utvikling og fleksible arbeidsvilkår. Vi tilbyr sterke pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, personalbillett på tog og et inkluderende sosialt miljø. Hos oss får du: Gode utviklingsmuligheter og kompetanseheving Permisjonsordninger som møter ditt behov Fleksibel arbeidstid og sommer- og vintertid Sentralt arbeidssted i Oslo Kantine med både varm og kald mat Treningsrom Sykkelparkering Muligheter for å jobbe noe hjemmefra Personalbillett med Go-Ahead, SJ Nord og VY sine tog Gunstige betingelser hos Jernbanens bank og forsikring (JBF) Muligheter til å bli kjent på tvers av Bane NOR gjennom bedriftsidrettslag og sosiale og faglige arrangementer Hos oss handler trivsel om mer enn bare jobben - nemlig summen av spennende oppgaver, gode kollegaer og fleksibilitet når livet krevet det. Vi har tro på at en god balanse bidrar til energi og trivsel både på jobb og hjemme! Dette kommer du til å gjøre Du vil lede prosjektavdelingen i Bane NOR Energi, inkludert personalansvar for prosjekt- og prosjekteringslederne i avdelingen. Stillingen har også et leveranseansvar for tildelt prosjektportefølje. Dette innebærer: Ivareta daglig utøvelse av prosjekteierrollen på vegne av Direktør Energi Ta stilling til virksomhetens behov og sikre at mål og gevinster kan realiseres Utpeke prosjektleder, og følge opp leveranser fra prosjektene Planlegging og gjennomføring av prosjekter: bestilling, planlegging, bygging og overlevering til Anleggseier Oppfølging og rapportering av leveranser opp mot fastsatte rammer og mål for økonomi, kvalitet, fremdrift, SHA/HMS, bærekraft, risiko Porteføljen består av vedlikeholds-, fornyelses og investeringsprosjekter over hele landet der det er elektrifisert jernbane. Det er til enhver tid rundt 30 prosjekter med høy teknisk kompleksitet og tverrfaglighet, som varierer i størrelsesorden fra 1 til 500 MNOK. Fagområder man kommer borti er alt fra grunnarbeider, konstruksjon og bygningsteknisk, til lavspent, høyspent, kraftelektronikk, automasjon og kontrollsystemer. I tillegg vil du ha et fagansvar for prosjektledelse, -prosess, styring og gjennomføring, inklusive utvikling, opplæring og bruk av metoder, maler og digitale verktøy. Dette er en stilling med stor variasjon i oppgavene og fleksibilitet mellom kontor, anleggsplass og hjemmekontor, noe som gir gode muligheter for å forme egen arbeidshverdag. Stillingen er definert som en ledende rolle, og er derfor unntatt arbeidstidsbestemmelsene i henhold til arbeidsmiljøloven 10-12 (1). Dette tror vi du trenger for å lykkes og trives Rollen passer for en tydelig og trygg leder skaper retning, bygger tillit og motiverer mennesker i krevende situasjoner. Du bør trives med variasjon, høyt tempo og ha gode evner til å prioritere mellom ulike hensyn som må balanseres. Til gjengjeld får du stort handlingsrom, frihet til å forme retning og arbeidsmetoder, og muligheten til å se konkrete resultater av innsatsen din. Dette er en rolle for deg som motiveres av påvirkningskraft, utvikling og en arbeidshverdag som aldri står stille. Vi ønsker at du har: Utdanning på masternivå innen et relevant fagområde, gjerne som sivilingeniør elektro, slik at du har en god faglig bakgrunn for lettere å forstå kompleksiteten i prosjektene våre Solid erfaring med prosjektledelse på seniornivå, med evne til å håndtere krevende prosjekter, tverrfaglige team og leveranser med høye kvalitetskrav Relevant ledererfaring, fortrinnsvis 3–5 år eller mer, der du har hatt ansvar for både mennesker, prioriteringer og resultater Kjekt å vite Å søke jobb i Bane NOR skal være enkelt. Du trenger ikke skrive søknadsbrev – en godt utfylt CV og dine svar i søknadsprosessen er alt vi trenger og ønsker fra deg. Bane NOR samarbeid med Semac for å gjennomføre bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater. Bakgrunnssjekken utføres etter samtykke fra deg, og innebærer verifisering av CV og annen søknadsdokumentasjon. Vil du sette spor, håper vi du tar kontakt med oss Rekrutterende leder: Kjetil Mikelborg, Direktør Energi ✆ (+47) 95832068 | ✉ kjetil.mikelborg@banenor.no
